rules.title: Borrow conflict requires same target, a mutable participant, and overlapping live regions
rules.statement: Two borrows b1, b2 of the same borrow target conflict iff (b1.target == b2.target) AND (b1.is_mut OR b2.is_mut) AND the inferred live point-sets of their regions intersect (∃ point P ∈ region(b1) ∩ region(b2)). Two shared (&) borrows of the same target never conflict; a borrow of a distinct target never conflicts.

rules.title: A mut reservation passed as a call argument tolerates concurrent shared reads of the same target
rules.statement: A two-phase-borrow (TPB) mut-reservation does not conflict with a concurrent shared (&) borrow of the same target: when one of a conflicting pair is a TPB reservation and the other is non-mut, no conflict is reported. A reservation still conflicts with any other mut borrow or reservation of the same target.

rules.title: Variable liveness computed by backward dataflow to fixed point
rules.statement: Liveness over program points (block, stmt-index) is solved by the standard backward dataflow equations: live_out(P) = ∪ live_in(succ(P)); live_in(P) = use(P) ∪ (live_out(P) \ def(P)). Within a block the successor of a statement is the next statement; the successor of the last statement is the union of live_in at the first statement of each CFG successor block; an empty block forwards its successors' live-in. The solution is the least fixed point.
